The replacement pair is an insert followed by a delete at pos + the insert length, as ShareJS stores one. `changes` in each decision index snapshot.trackedChanges; changes are walked in ascending pos.

Wire forms: libraries/overleaf-editor-core/lib/operation/scan_op.js:337-342 (tracked retain as {r, tracking}), :417-418 (remove as -n); libraries/overleaf-editor-core/lib/file_data/clear_tracking_props.js:39 (tracking {type: 'none'}); libraries/overleaf-editor-core/lib/operation/text_operation.js:248 ({textOperation}), :295 (base length equals the raw length).

Expected snapshots: libraries/overleaf-editor-core/lib/file_data/tracked_change_list.js:239-264 (a remove drops the ranges it covers and shifts later ones), :289-342 (a tracking-none retain drops the ranges it covers), :370 (ranges merge after the operation); libraries/overleaf-editor-core/lib/file_data/string_file_data.js:50-57 (trackedChanges omitted when empty). No two remaining ranges touch with the same type and user, so none merge.
